mechanics.claim: Renata and allies struck are granted a shield, enemies struck take magic damage and are slowed.
mechanics.quote: '''Renata''' and allies struck are granted a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and enemies struck are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for 2 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Rockets strike targets around Renata instantly, then converge and travel as a missile that strikes targets along its path and explodes at the target location, so a single target could be hit multiple times.
mechanics.quote: sends out chemtech rockets from either side of her that instantly strike targets around her. After {{rutngt|0.4}} they converge and travel to the target location as a single missile, striking targets along its path and exploding upon reaching the target location.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield can block either the initial rockets in-flight or the missile's explosion.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block either the rockets while they are in-flight or their explosion.
